newsitem.title: UK: European raw cotton markets dampened by New York.
newsitem.headline: European raw cotton markets dampened by New York.

text.p: Trading on Europe's raw cotton markets slackened off as prices found fresh direction from New York futures, industry sources said.
After Thursday's spate of mill-buying in key north-western markets said to be based on the recent stability of cash values, retracement in U.S. futures discouraged further activity, they said.
A limited amount of enquiry for Central Asian and West African origins for second-quarter shipment was seen in Germany and Italy but there were no firm trades reported.
Enquiry in Portugal continued active with delivery dates extending as far as the third quarter, local trade sources said. --London Newsroom, +44 171 542 8071
